decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory with still unresolved demand, its carrying cost is small relative to the option value, so keep it.
As a core product line promoted on the home page and with remaining market uncertainty, the option to expand justifies keeping it.
The niche car transporter line still holds option value under uncertainty, and its carrying cost is moderate, so keep it.
Low-bed trailer series remains strategically relevant and its uncertainty is not resolved, so the option value supports keeping it.
High trailer cover series is a complementary product line with low-to-moderate carrying costs, so keep the option open.
This appears to duplicate the existing box car trailer series (Product B), creating a redundant option that consumes resources without adding option value, so drop it.
